About
About Mf Lobster & Ceviche

Mf Lobster & Ceviche is a seafood-focused restaurant located at 3711 Autry Pk Dr Suite 100, Houston, TX 77019, and it presents itself as a polished yet welcoming destination for anyone who appreciates lobster prepared in a variety of thoughtful ways. From the moment you step inside, the space feels intentionally designed, with a modern dining environment that sets the tone for a relaxed but elevated experience. Even during busier moments like shift changes or opening weekends, the staff maintain a friendly, attentive presence, offering helpful guidance through the menu and confidently recommending signature dishes. The bar program stands out as well, with cocktails such as cucumber martinis crafted carefully and balanced, showing clear attention to detail rather than relying on gimmicks. The menu highlights lobster across multiple formats, giving diners the chance to explore it beyond the expected; lobster tacos and lobster ceviche are vibrant and well-executed, while the lobster roll is frequently praised for its quality and flavor, often described as one of the best diners have tried. Starters like the house salad and mussels in garlic sauce provide solid supporting options, rounding out the meal without overshadowing the main attractions. While certain items, such as the lobster bisque or crudo, may land differently depending on personal taste, the overall consistency of the food leaves a strong impression. Service plays a significant role in shaping the experience, with staff showing genuine pride in both the food and the guest experience, making diners feel cared for without being overbearing. The combination of a thoughtfully curated menu, well-made drinks, appealing interior design, and attentive service creates an atmosphere that feels both approachable and special, making the restaurant a comfortable choice for casual dinners, first visits, or returning guests eager to try something new like the lobster roll they may have missed before.

Reviews

“ Great experience at MF Lobster. The service was wonderful and the food was excellent. Pricing is very fair for the quality of the dishes. The lobster bisque was really good to start. The chili prawn and grilled oysters were tasty but the raw oysters lacked flavor despite a small dressing of wasabi on top so will avoid those next time. Lobster tacos and the lobster roll hit the spot as mains for sure. Overall great experience and can't wait to get back to try some of their other items on the menu. ”

Brian Carpani, GeckoMediaGroup

“ It's a small but beautiful place. Inside is more glamorous for a nice date night, outside is more relaxed for a laidback night. Beautiful atmosphere inside and out. It is without a doubt that the lobsters, oysters, n clams are super fresh n sweet. Keep in mind when I describe the lobsters or seafood as being "sweet", i don't mean that they are sweet like desserts. I mean u can taste the natural sweetness of the fresh seafoods, rather than frozen seafoods that have been marinaded in salt water and they have lost their natural sweetness. Best clam chowder I've ever had, loaded with sweet tasty clams in every bite! Lobster bisque was also amazing, clean tasting broth with fresh chunks of lobster, it's rare to find a good lobster bisque that's not briny. Lobster rolls r also super buttery and loaded with fresh lobsters. But let's talk about the lobster bao, omg.. all these years growing up in china town, I've never had a bao like this.. believe me when I say the bao is so amazing! It's super thin, warm, soft n chewy, but light, NOT doughy, spongy, or dry like the baos u eat in china town. It is also loaded with huge chunks of crispy baked lobsters in this amazing creamy Japanese mayo and unagi sauce. ”

Kathryn Nguyen

“ We came opening weekend and absolutely loved it. We ordered the house salad, a cucumber martini, lobster bisque, lobster tacos and lobster ceviche. We gave everything a 10 out of 10 except on the lobster bisque my husband rates that is six. I love lobster bisque and I’m pretty picky I think it was eight. I will definitely wear it again. Everything else was fantastic, Staff great. Restaurant design was great. Bringing our son back to try the lobster roll. ”

Lyndsay Baker

“ I came during the shift change. The staff were very friendly and helpful in recommending signature dishes to try and I was not disappointed. The drinks were made with attention to detail and were very tasty. This staff definitely took pride in making our experience as well as possible considering the shift change. ”

Dominic Z

“ We had a very pleasant dinner. The dining environment, service and food were excellent. One of the best lobster rolls I’ve ever had. The mussels in garlic sauce were also very good. The crudo however was just okay. Would definitely recommend a visit. ”

Christopher

“ Found this gem while searching for some good lobster rolls and boy were amazed. Waiter recommended a few good wines but they were out of the one we were leaning towards, so we got an Argentinian Pinot noir. Wine was great got a bottle . As an appetizer we got the spicy tuna avocado tartar. Tuna was tossed in a wasabi based sauce with some fresh avocado and sliced Serrano Pepper with some greens on top. Flavor was very refreshing and light. Next dish was the mussels and bread, mussels came out cooked just right in white wine garlic butter sauce. Sauce was so good , that you used the bread to finish all the sauce! They have a few types of rolls but the waiter recommended the Butter chives lobster roll. The lobster was cooked to perfection , with a light refreshing lemony butter sauce, and perfectly toasted roll. Best lobster roll I’ve had in Houston. Lobster bisque was not heavy cream based as most , bisque had great flavor and was also light and refreshing. Definitely looking forward to trying some of the waiters suggestions: lobster tacos , lobster bao and any of the ceviche’s. ”

Fredrick Moreno

“ I had a wonderful meal tonight at MF Lobster & Ceviche. I was the first one to dine here on opening day and very impressed with the food and staff. I could not have had a better experience and can’t wait to try other items on the menu. Lobster Roll, Lobster Ceviche and Clam Chowder were all exceptional. ”

Jim Gossen

“ Top! Recommend. Will return. Chose the scallop ceviche which had a hint of spice, very fresh and supple, and the chips were crispy and light. Lobster bisque was creamy and flavorful. We enjoyed the mussels and the white wine sauce. I will order all these again. Also, sitting outside facing the park and with live mellow music was a very enjoyable. Inside is beautiful, but a was a little cold for us. ”

John D
